source.description: Approved raster contact sheet cropped from one consistent pencil-sketch process.
source.notes: One diagonal vine, one cluster of exactly nine round grapes, two lobed leaves, one curly tendril, open-paper highlights, and a small broken shadow stay stable. The private first sheet was rejected because it missed the original twelve-grape count.

process_strategy: Six cumulative pencil panels begin with a grape-cluster scaffold and only add graphite and restrained purple-green color after all fruit and leaves exist.

final_elements.name: vine and cluster scaffold
final_elements.description: One diagonal vine route around a hanging cluster of nine grape circles.

final_elements.name: nine grapes
final_elements.description: Exactly nine round grapes in a tapering cluster.

final_elements.name: two leaves and tendril
final_elements.description: Two lobed leaves and one short curled tendril attached to the vine.

final_elements.name: highlights and shadow
final_elements.description: Small highlight gaps and one broken ground shadow.

final_elements.name: graphite texture and color
final_elements.description: Layered graphite, restrained violet, green, and warm-brown pencil texture.

overlap_reservations.background_lines_stop_before: Vine lines stop at each reserved grape and leaf silhouette; leaf veins never continue through a grape.

frames.visible_job: Place pale vine, nine grape circles, two leaf envelopes, tendril route, highlight gaps, and shadow footprint.
Refine the same vine, nine grape contours, and two leaf silhouettes.
Add leaf lobes, simple veins, and the existing curled tendril.
Add tiny stem seams, established highlight gaps, and the broken shadow.
Layer graphite hatching and restrained color on established grapes, vine, leaves, and shadow.

final_step.visible_job: Only deepen established contour, graphite texture, restrained color, highlights, and shadow.

rejection_checks: Exactly nine grapes, two leaves, and one tendril persist in all later panels.
No final element appears first in the final frame.
No vine or vein line is erased for a late overlap.
Every adjacent panel has a distinct instructional job.
